list.label: Agents
list.lockedTip: Hoody owns this agent. Only its model can change.
list.sameModelTip: This agent has no model of its own, so it uses the model of the chat it runs in.
col.name: Name
title: Agents
subtitle: What each agent does and which tools it may use, on {{computer}}. Pick one to see and change it.
subtitleBare: What each agent does and which tools it may use. Pick one to see and change it.
allRealms.title: Pick a realm to see its agents
allRealms.body: Agents belong to one realm. Choose a realm from the realm menu at the top (on a phone, tap the realm square).
tools.tip.default: Hoody's standard set of tools. It applies when the agent lists none of its own.
tools.tip.none: This agent has no tools. It can only talk.
tools.base: A base: Hoody adds what this agent needs
state.failed: Couldn't read the agents on this computer.
state.stale: Couldn't read the agents list again. This shows the last list read.
state.goneKept: This agent is no longer in the list. Your unsaved changes are kept until you leave.
leave.alsoTicks: Your tool ticks for {{name}} are not saved either.
held.loss: Your unsaved changes to “{{name}}” are lost if you switch realm or sign out.
state.emptyBody: Agents are the definitions chats and helpers run on. The shipped ones appear once the agent program on this computer answers.
state.gone: “{{name}}” is no longer in the list. It may have been renamed or deleted.
prov.tip.project: A file in this folder, used for chats that run here.
prov.tip.userShipped: Hoody's shipped agent with a copy in your files. The copy is the one that runs.
prov.tip.embedded: Hoody's shipped agent as it comes. This computer has no file for it.
prov.tip.owned: Hoody owns this agent. Only its model can change.
model.notSent: Nothing was sent: {{model}} can't be used here now. Choose another model.
model.unread: Nothing was sent: the models on this computer haven't been read yet. Try again in a moment.
model.stillNot: Not there yet. Check again in a moment.
model.stop.title: Stop tracking this change?
model.stop.body: Every page and tab stops waiting for this change. It isn't undone: it may still go through later, even over a change you make next.
effort.help: How much the model thinks before it answers. Model default uses the model's own level.
effort.refused: Not changed: {{name}}'s file or model refused this level. Its model may not take it (Extra high needs a model that does), its file may turn thinking off, or another setting in its file may be invalid. Check its source, or pick another level.
ov.skillsEvery: Every enabled skill in chats; none when spawned as a helper
ov.skillsDepend: Skills depend on this agent's tools
ov.fileNone: Built in, no file on this computer
ov.default: New chats start on this agent.
ov.owned: Hoody owns this agent, so its definition is read-only. Only its model can change.
ov.unknownTools: Tools this agent names that are not Hoody tools: {{list}}
ov.unknownSkills: Skills this agent names that are not installed here: {{list}}
ov.missing: Tools the shipped {{name}} has and this file does not: {{list}}
